We must ensure that all eligible American voters have the ability to cast their votes safely, securely, and without obstruction.  

In Texas and across our country, we have seen an increasing assault on the ability to exercise this right and responsibility of citizenship.

Today, I tested positive for a breakthrough case of COVID-19. I have been testing regularly, and am fully vaccinated and boosted. I’m grateful to only have mild symptoms and am quarantining and following CDC guidance.

Last year on this day, we celebrated the passage of the Pregnant Workers Fairness Act in the House.

Today, I call on the Senate to pass it and ensure the fair treatment and accommodation of pregnant workers--something everyone should support. https://t.co/DObff813zh

The first time a professional recognizes that someone is exhibiting symptoms of a mental health condition is often at a doctor's office. By increasing behavioral health resources in primary care settings, we can help more people get the help they need.

Every week, I send out my newsletter detailing my votes in Congress. This final day of Early Voting week, it's your turn to vote!

Visit https://t.co/XJntD1C2VE for details & links on when and where you can exercise your right to vote and make a plan to vote today or on Tuesday. https://t.co/7YPdqlrJI3

Lymphedema, a chronic condition, can be treated w/ compression items that currently aren't covered by Medicare.

As a co-sponsor of the Lymphedema Treatment Act, I was proud to join @JanSchakowsky in voting to expand Medicare coverage to include lymphedema compression treatment.

If you're interested in improving your mental health but aren't sure where to start, visit the newly launched https://t.co/e98M78sesX.

This one-stop-shop has info on how you can:
🏥 Find health care or support
📘 Learn about treatment
🫂 Help someone
☎️ Get help now

September is Suicide Prevention Awareness Month, a time to remember those affected by suicide and recommit to expanding access to mental health treatment for those who need it most.

If you or someone you know is in crisis, call or text 𝟵𝟴𝟴 for free, confidential help 24/7. https://t.co/8DfEUQgmxz

📰 Great news: FEMA has awarded more than $12.5 million for repairs to #TX07's Southwest Wastewater Treatment Plant.

These federal funds are part of the ongoing efforts to rebuild critical city infrastructure after Hurricane Harvey, and I'm glad to see that the work continues.

35 years since the first #WorldAIDSDay, progress has been made, but the fight is far from over.

Today, we honor the memories of those we’ve lost by continuing to push for research, treatment, and support. Together, we can make a difference and end the HIV Epidemic. https://t.co/KChku7FtWz
Like people across our community, I am sad to learn of the diagnosis of my friend and colleague Congresswoman Sheila Jackson Lee. (1/3)

As she undergoes cancer treatment, I am confident that she will approach her treatment plan with the same tenacity that she has wielded while serving our community and our country so well, and I join Houstonians in sending her strength and encouragement during this time. (3/3)

More than 2/3 of all women experience uterine fibroids in their lifetime—yet there is no federal program to support detection, research, and treatment.

I'm glad to co-sponsor @repshontel's U-FIGHT Act to empower women to make informed decisions about their bodies. https://t.co/2eM2TLqErR

President Johnson signed the #VotingRights Act into law 59 years ago this week. 

Our fellow citizens fought and died for the right to vote. We must carry on their work and must restore the Voting Right Act to ensure that Americans can exercise this sacred right and privilege. https://t.co/eAqh21HBbr

This #BlackBusinessMonth, I was glad to tour Stan's Hands in #TX07 and to talk with him about opportunities and challenges, including recovery following Beryl, and to hear his story about how he started his wellness business. https://t.co/63L3CW0jvL

With all that is going on, it is important today that we remember and honor Fred Korematsu, who fought  internment of Japanese Americans in WWII, taking his case to the Supreme Court to fight against injustice and for fair treatment for all Americans. https://t.co/1fAX00Zxp4 https://t.co/rwerHMTOsb
Elon Musk's conflicts of interest are many and dangerous. We must exercise our oversight and protect the American people. [2/2]

60 years ago today, hundreds of Americans marching from Selma to Montgomery to exercise their right to vote were attacked on what became Bloody Sunday. Today, the fight continues—which is why I have cosponsored the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act. We must pass it. https://t.co/3x8vIdrXj9

Like people across the country, I am saddened to learn of President Biden’s prostate cancer diagnosis. He has devoted so much of his life of service to fighting this devastating disease, as I know he will now. President Biden and his entire family are in my thoughts and prayers as they face this challenge.

From questioning vaccine science to undermining critical research at our hospitals to dismantling HHS programs, Secretary Kennedy's actions have caused great concern in #TX07.

Tomorrow, he will testify before the E&C committee. Watch here at 9am CDT ➡️ https://t.co/9DmqVFdxEv

Last week, on the third anniversary of the Dobbs decision, HHS Secretary Kennedy appeared before @EnergyCommerce, where he admitted and stated clearly that federal law #EMTALA requires hospitals to provide stabilizing medical treatment for pregnant patients, including but not limited to abortion, in all 50 states. This is important for our ER docs and others, as states have banned abortion over the last three years have created confusion and fear that puts patients' lives and health at risk.

Today’s ruling by the Senate Parliamentarian allowing for the Republican budget bill to defund Planned Parenthood makes the stakes of this fight even higher. Not only is the Medicaid coverage of millions of Americans on the line—but so is women’s access to basic reproductive health care. My Republican colleagues still have time to do the right thing and stop this disastrous bill. https://t.co/8YUPupzvIW

This #NationalImmunizationMonth, as kids head back to school, they'll be protected against diseases like chicken pox, measles, tetanus, and more, thanks to vaccines. Find vaccines near you:

Harris County: https://t.co/kY7eqAlsXS

Fort Bend County: https://t.co/gtfh3pbOBj https://t.co/43Fd7NPR8i

This #NationalHealthCenterWeek, I visited the HOPE Clinic to highlight both the important work clinics do to keep our community healthy as well as the Medicaid funding upon which they rely.

Republican cuts to Medicaid imperil their work, putting patients at risk. I have opposed these cuts at every opportunity on behalf of our #TX07 neighbors and our providers and will continue to do so.

We're in the midst of an affordability crisis and yet, Republicans just passed a bill that will make Medicaid harder to get and health care marketplace premiums more expensive.

They're turning their backs on working families' health in favor of billionaires' tax cuts. #YouDeserveBetter 
https://t.co/NUf4rdQS78
